name: hedera-demo
description: Hedera-native Next.js demo without local Solidity workspaces.

steps.text: Hedera native services: no contract deploy is required to run or test this demo.

steps.label: Optional: set NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLET_CONNECT_PROJECT_ID
steps.text: A built-in fallback project id works for local demos; set your own for production. Optional: also set NEXT_PUBLIC_PROOF_WALL_TOPIC_ID after creating a topic in /admin.

steps.label: Try the demo
steps.text: Open /admin to create an HCS topic and HTS badge token, then post proofs on the home page.
